selection.title: RL4CO: An Extensive Reinforcement Learning for Combinatorial Optimization Benchmark
selection.authors: Federico Berto et al.; Jinkyoo Park is a listed co-author.
selection.contribution: A shared research framework spanning 27 combinatorial-optimization environments and 23 baselines, with modular training and evaluation.
selection.relevance: Reusable optimization infrastructure and systematic comparison of learned solvers.
selection.note: The author-maintained arXiv record identifies KDD 2025 Oral and links the ACM DOI. Authorship and the 27/23 counts are visible in the paper.

selection.title: PARCO: Parallel AutoRegressive Models for Multi-Agent Combinatorial Optimization
selection.authors: Federico Berto, Chuanbo Hua, Laurin Luttmann, Jiwoo Son, Junyoung Park, Kyuree Ahn, Changhyun Kwon, Lin Xie, Jinkyoo Park.
selection.contribution: Parallel solution construction with agent communication and conflict handling for multi-agent routing and scheduling.
selection.relevance: Coordinated decision-making across multiple vehicles or resources.
selection.note: NeurIPS proceedings confirm the conference year and Jinkyoo Park in the author list.

selection.title: Sym-NCO: Leveraging Symmetricity for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
selection.authors: Minsu Kim, Junyoung Park, Jinkyoo Park.
selection.contribution: Symmetry-based reinforcement-learning regularization evaluated across four routing-related optimization tasks.
selection.relevance: Generalization across problem representations and learning efficient optimization policies.
selection.note: NeurIPS proceedings confirm the conference year, authors and author-linked source code.

selection.title: Meta-SAGE: Scale Meta-Learning Scheduled Adaptation with Guided Exploration for Mitigating Scale Shift on Combinatorial Optimization
selection.authors: Jiwoo Son, Minsu Kim, Hyeonah Kim, Jinkyoo Park.
selection.contribution: Adapts pretrained optimization policies to larger instances using scale-aware representations and guided test-time exploration.
selection.relevance: Research on scaling learned solvers beyond their training-instance sizes.
selection.note: PMLR confirms ICML 2023 and all four authors; the abstract links the source repository.

selection.title: Learning to CROSS exchange to solve min-max vehicle routing problems
selection.authors: Minjun Kim, Junyoung Park, Jinkyoo Park.
selection.contribution: A graph neural network predicts promising route exchanges to guide a conventional search operator for min-max vehicle routing.
selection.relevance: Hybrid AI and operations-research methods for practical routing decisions.
selection.note: ICLR confirms authorship and the accepted title above. The linked earlier preprint uses the title “Neuro CROSS exchange: Learning to CROSS exchange to solve realistic vehicle routing problems”.

selection.title: DevFormer: A Symmetric Transformer for Context-Aware Device Placement
selection.authors: Haeyeon Kim, Minsu Kim, Federico Berto, Joungho Kim, Jinkyoo Park.
selection.contribution: Context-aware transformer optimization for decoupling-capacitor placement, evaluated in simulated and real hardware.
selection.relevance: Evidence of optimization research breadth beyond logistics, including semiconductor-related design.
selection.note: PMLR confirms ICML 2023 and the author list. The author repository provides code and a placement benchmark.
